notes.title: Lunar Year Limited Event
notes.content:
Happy new Lunar year everyone!
Lets celebrate with the next (and for now also last) seasonal event for Claw Machine Sim. 
By now you know the drill: You have 3 weeks to win all new limited seasonal prizes.

This update also includes various newly supported languages!

[h1]Time Limited Lunar Year Event[/h1]

[list]
[*]Unique Lunar Year Collection
[*]Lunar Year prizes spawn as every 7th prize refilled
[*]They only spawn during the limited event (Until the 12th of February)
[*]If you unlock them during this time, they will spawn as normal prizes afterwards
[*]Complete the collection to unlock the lunar year sticker on the claw machine
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230809/ff4dfe4a9c4c8ec28ccf788e7697d87f00bac062.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230809/55d6f110f19f0a4727b6d83fcda2c8907ac04b9f.png[/img]


[h1]More languages supported[/h1]

This update also introduces full support for the following languages:
[list]
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Arabic
[*] Hindi
[*] Indonesian
[*] Italien
[*] Polish
[*] Thai
[*] Turkish
[*] Ukranian
[*] Vietnamese
[/list]

All these translations were created using Ai translation tools. Let me know if you find any weird translations in your language. 

[h2]Future Updates[/h2]
This update doesn't mean that this will be a regular thing. Don't expect any future updates. They might come, they might not come. So only buy this game if you are happy with whats already there! Also, as mentioned above, this will most likely be the last seasonal event for now. 

[b]Enjoy playing Claw Machine Sim? Consider leaving a review, they help alot![/b]

notes.title: Christmas Update - Time limited Event
notes.content:
Merry Christmas everyone! 
Santa was really proud seeing how you already wrote [b]140 reviews with an positive average of 95%![/b]
Therefore you get an early present this year: A new seasonal event! 

I didn't expect to reach so many people with this game and it makes me really happy to see so many enjoying it! Thanks to everyone!

[h1]Time Limited Christmas Event[/h1]

[list]
[*] Unique Christmas Collection
[*] Christmas prizes spawn as every 7th prize refilled
[*] They only spawn during the limited event (Until the 29th of December)
[*] If you unlock them during this time, they will spawn as normal prizes afterwards
[*] Complete the collection to unlock the christmas sticker on the claw machine
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230809/61cef6e2c205819adbe2d816ef29f976f394133d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230809/4d1434338127a58255a9555acc1c74a046fe7c4a.png[/img]




[h1]Immersive Camera Setting[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new setting that puts the camera right infront of the window
[*] For people with their own physical joysticks to create a more immersive experience
[*] The refill button can't the clicked this way anymore. The shortcut is "R"
[/list]
This feature was suggested by phant0mg33k.64 with his awesome claw machien setup. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230809/12f5cb922bd4c8d5fc7f96ac2b3cb4a477bd2533.jpg[/img]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3353172720

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added seasonal new year's decorations that will be activated automatically at the end of the year. You will need to log in to see what they look like :) 
[*] Fixed an issue preventing people from receiving the everything unlocked achivements. You need to win a prize in normal or realistic mode to trigger them now, if you didn't receive them yet.
[*] Slight performance and loading time improvements.
[/list]

[h1]Future Updates[/h1]
This update doesn't mean that this will be a regular thing. Don't expect any future updates. They might come, they might not come. So only buy this game if you are happy with whats already there! :)


[b]Also in case you enjoy Claw Machine Sim and haven't already: Consider leaving a review :)[/b]

notes.title: Halloween Update - Time Limited Event
notes.content:
Welcome to the spooky season and the first content update for Claw Machine Sim!
From today until the November 2nd you have the chance to win and collect all 13 limited Halloween prizes!


[h1]Time Limited Halloween Event[/h1]
[list]
[*] Unique halloween collection
[*] Halloween prizes spawn as every 8th prize refilled
[*] They only spawn during the limited event (Until 2nd of November)
[*] If you unlock them during this time, they will spawn as normal prizes afterwards
[*] Complete the collection to unlock the halloween sticker on the claw machine
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230809/df268876823b5d117ac5d0139641eb907cd6f1c4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230809/0efe73a99f82e5b0f0dd8bc866d9213b63d78b54.png[/img]



[h1]New normal Prizes[/h1]
[list]
[*] 15 new unique prizes for you to win, even outside of the Halloween event
[*] Also includes the all new Spinning Tops collection
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230809/daf872ccf72cdd6a0f4394ea43de8da6d17c533b.png[/img]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved save system for more stability
[*] Fixed some names & localizations
[/list]

[b]Also in case you enjoy Claw Machine Sim and haven't already: Consider leaving a review :)[/b]

[h1]Future Updates[/h1]
This update doesn't mean that this will be a regular thing. Don't expect any future updates. They might come, they might not come. So only buy this game if you are happy with whats already there! :)

notes.title: Adjustments #03
notes.content:
[h2]Prize Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crisps bags are smaller
[*] Candy boxes have more friction
[*] Keyboard has improved colliders
[*] Sloth has reduced weight
[*] Handheld consoles have reduced weight
[/list]

[h2]Game Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed [i]Win 2 prizes at the same time[/i] Achievement. You had to win 3 before lol
[*] Fixed an issue with the Refill button that would lock the controls
[*] Fixed an issue with the Refill button that would grant you an additional free refill
[*] Fixed japansese localization for "Graphics" thanks to YUZUPI68
[*] Added collision sounds when kicking trash
[/list]
[i]Let me know if you find more translation issues in any language![/i]


[h2]Reduced Rope Slack[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rope now has a length of 55 cm instead of the previous 70 cm when fully lowered
[*] This allows for some new skill grabs and reduces unwanted failures
[/list]

Here is an example of whats possible now:

[b]Old length (70cm)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230809/5610dc54aee47ce1b0cfd70d542db1807cf91cfa.gif[/img]

[b]New length (55 cm)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230809/18189625714669ff63760bea83c341b09751a864.gif[/img]

Let me know what you think of these changes. 
And if you haven't already, consider writing a review! :)


- Lukas
